title: Ted Owens warns of Challenger shuttle loss on Christmas Eve 1985
place_text: United States (phone call to Mishlove); Challenger launch

tellings.quote: Christmas Eve 1985, I got a phone call from Ted Owens. And in his big booming voice, he said, "You have to notify the US government not to send up the next space shuttle because if they do, my UFOs are going to knock it right out of the sky." A few weeks later, the Challenger explosion occurred.
Ted Owens wrote a series of threatening letters to the US government saying that he's going to target the space shuttles one after another.
tellings.difference: Describes a series of threatening letters to the US government targeting the shuttles one after another, rather than a Christmas Eve 1985 phone call to Mishlove.
tellings.link_reason: The same claim that Owens warned before Challenger that his UFOs would bring down the shuttles.

as_told.title: Ted Owens' threatening letters naming the space shuttles before the Challenger explosion

plain: On Christmas Eve 1985, a man named Ted Owens, who spoke of UFOs as his own, phoned to say the US government must not launch the next space shuttle, because "my UFOs are going to knock it right out of the sky." The researcher of psychics Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a doctorate, says he took that call himself, and that a few weeks later the Challenger shuttle exploded, which would mean the warning came true. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells it a little differently, saying Owens wrote a series of threatening letters to the government about targeting the shuttles one after another.
